# Owner settings

<!-- Generated by `node tooling/scripts/owner-settings.mjs`. Edit the code or `tooling/profiles/test-owner-values.json`, then rerun. -->

Every value below is blank on purpose until the owners publish it. A blank one refuses with a typed `_unset` code and the room shows the refusal (AGENTS.md, product law). Nothing here is a product default. This file does not hold real values; it names what is missing.

114 env settings, 183 owner values read elsewhere, 207 page sizes the caller sends. 475 distinct `_unset` codes in all.

## TEST profile

`tooling/profiles/test-owner-values.json` holds 23 values labelled **TEST**. A rig (CX-8, the local test stack) loads them so a fund, trade and withdraw journey runs. `node tooling/scripts/owner-settings.mjs --profile` prints them as exports and refuses unless `APP_ENV` is `dev` or `test`. They are never a product default and never reach a real environment.
